ENS_MEAN.aggregation_rule: p_inv_mean = mean_{m in 1..3} p_inv_m; mask k >= 1 where p_inv_mean[k] >= 0.10 to -inf; s_mean = mean_{m in 1..3} ranker_score_m; j* = argmax_k masked(s_mean)[k]; switch from slot 0 to j* iff (s_mean[j*] - s_mean[0]) > mean(strict_margin_m) AND sum_{m=1..3} sum_{b=0..7} 1[(bag_{m,b}[j*] - bag_{m,b}[0]) > strict_margin_m] >= 18

ENS_MEAN_PROPOSER.aggregation_rule: p_inv_mean = mean_{m in 1..3} p_inv_m; mask k >= 1 where p_inv_mean[k] >= 0.10 to -inf; s_mean = mean_{m in 1..3} ranker_score_m; j* = argmax_k masked(s_mean)[k]; switch from slot 0 to j* iff (s_mean[j*] - s_mean[0]) > mean(strict_margin_m)

ENS_VOTE2.aggregation_rule: Each member m in {279101, 279102, 279103} computes its frozen H284 BAG_SWITCH (q=6) pick p_m in 0..7; switch away from slot 0 to candidate j >= 1 iff at least 2 of 3 members have p_m == j; else slot 0.

ENS_VOTE3.aggregation_rule: Each member m in {279101, 279102, 279103} computes its frozen H284 BAG_SWITCH (q=6) pick p_m in 0..7; switch away from slot 0 to candidate j >= 1 iff all 3 of 3 members have p_m == j; else slot 0.

CLIP.aggregation_rule: 3-seed BAG_SWITCH (q=6) refit on DL-Train with per-context training utility clipped at -1.0 so -2.0 invalid picks do not dominate inner hyperparameter selection loss.

CLIP_ENS_VOTE2.aggregation_rule: Majority (>=2 of 3) candidate-agreement ensemble over the 3 CLIP BAG_SWITCH (q=6) policies.
